records.context: Make Masks' point mode marks one point per object instead of painting a mask: a curator clicks the centre of every nucleus in an extracted image region, and a scorer later asks which segmented object each point falls in. This module is the session behind that mode. It holds the points of one image, the undo stack, and the file the points are saved to, in plain Python, so the round trip is tested without a display. :mod:`spacr.qt.point_annotator` is the window that drives it.
records.label: spacr.point_annotation#1
records.source: Make Masks' point mode marks one point per object instead of painting a mask: a curator clicks the centre of every nucleus in a crop, and a scorer later asks which segmented object each point falls in. This module is the session behind that mode. It holds the points of one image, the undo stack, and the file the points are saved to, in plain Python, so the round trip is tested without a display. :mod:`spacr.qt.point_annotator` is the window that drives it.
records.translation: Make Masks का बिंदु मोड मास्क पेंट करने के बजाय प्रति वस्तु एक बिंदु चिह्नित करता है: क्यूरेटर किसी निकाले गए छवि क्षेत्र में हर नाभिक के केंद्र पर क्लिक करता है, और बाद में एक स्कोरर पूछता है कि प्रत्येक बिंदु किस खंडित वस्तु के भीतर पड़ता है। यह मॉड्यूल उस मोड के पीछे का सत्र है। यह एक छवि के बिंदु, पूर्ववत स्टैक, और वह फ़ाइल जिसमें बिंदु सहेजे जाते हैं, साधारण Python में रखता है, ताकि पूरी आवाजाही का परीक्षण बिना डिस्प्ले के हो सके। :mod:`spacr.qt.point_annotator` वह विंडो है जो इसे चलाती है।

records.context: The folder is opened as the resumable curation work list of :mod:`spacr.curation_queue`: its ``curate_status.csv`` records which images are done, so a session closed half way reopens where it stopped. A folder that holds only images, with no ``masks/`` folder beside them, is accepted as the ``images`` layout, because point mode reads no masks.
records.label: spacr.point_annotation#2
records.source: The folder is opened as the resumable curation queue of :mod:`spacr.curation_queue`: its ``curate_status.csv`` records which images are done, so a session closed half way reopens where it stopped. A folder that holds only images, with no ``masks/`` folder beside them, is accepted as the ``images`` layout, because point mode reads no masks.
records.translation: फ़ोल्डर को :mod:`spacr.curation_queue` की पुनः आरंभ योग्य क्यूरेशन कार्य सूची के रूप में खोला जाता है: इसकी ``curate_status.csv`` दर्ज करती है कि कौन-सी छवियाँ पूरी हो चुकी हैं, इसलिए बीच में बंद किया गया सत्र वहीं से फिर खुलता है जहाँ वह रुका था। जिस फ़ोल्डर में केवल छवियाँ हों और उनके बगल में कोई ``masks/`` फ़ोल्डर न हो, उसे ``images`` लेआउट के रूप में स्वीकार किया जाता है, क्योंकि बिंदु मोड कोई मास्क नहीं पढ़ता।

records.context: ``X`` and ``Y``: the clicked pixel's column and row in image pixels, origin at the top left, written as floats. This is the convention of Fiji's Analyze -> Measure on a multi-point selection, and a scorer that reads ``P[["Y", "X"]]``, rounds and indexes a label image gets back exactly the pixel that was clicked;

records.context: The window steps through a :func:`spacr.point_annotation.build_point_queue` session. Each image is shown on its own, blind: the outlines a scorer will compare the points against are not on application view. The controls are:

records.source: The window steps through a :func:`spacr.point_annotation.build_point_queue` session. Each image is shown on its own, blind: the outlines a scorer will compare the points against are not on screen. The controls are:
records.translation: विंडो एक :func:`spacr.point_annotation.build_point_queue` सत्र में क्रम से आगे बढ़ती है। प्रत्येक छवि अलग से, ब्लाइंड रूप में दिखाई जाती है: जिन रूपरेखाओं से स्कोरर बिंदुओं की तुलना करेगा वे स्क्रीन पर नहीं होतीं। नियंत्रण ये हैं:

records.label: spacr.qt.point_annotator#2

records.context: Every change is saved at once by :class:`spacr.point_annotation.PointSession`. An overlay folder can be shown only after every image of the folder is marked done (or from the start when the session was opened with ``hide_overlays`` off). While an overlay is on application view the points cannot be changed, so that the outlines never steer an annotation.
records.label: spacr.qt.point_annotator#8
records.source: Every change is saved at once by :class:`spacr.point_annotation.PointSession`. An overlay folder can be shown only after every image of the folder is marked done (or from the start when the session was opened with ``hide_overlays`` off). While an overlay is on screen the points cannot be changed, so that the outlines never steer an annotation.
records.translation: हर परिवर्तन :class:`spacr.point_annotation.PointSession` द्वारा तुरंत सहेजा जाता है। ओवरले फ़ोल्डर तभी दिखाया जा सकता है जब फ़ोल्डर की हर छवि पूर्ण चिह्नित हो जाए (या शुरू से ही, जब सत्र ``hide_overlays`` बंद रखकर खोला गया हो)। जब तक ओवरले स्क्रीन पर है, बिंदु बदले नहीं जा सकते, ताकि रूपरेखाएँ कभी किसी एनोटेशन को प्रभावित न करें।
